skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the principles and management of municipal finance.
Analyze and evaluate budgeting, financial reporting, and accounting balance sheets.
Collect and analyze information from various sources, and present findings through group work and presentations.
Work effectively in groups, presenting and discussing findings.
Analyze and evaluate financial activities and situations in urban contexts.
Understand and apply ethical principles in financial management.
Understand urban economic principles and their impact on municipal finance.
Apply budgeting principles to manage municipal finances effectively.
Analyze financial trends and challenges in municipal finance.
Effectively present and defend financial analysis and solutions.
